_comment: One value per fact, one primary source, one owner page. Built from the 2026-10-01 fact audit (audit/evidence/facts.md): 12 facts disagreed across pages and several known traps from the website's HANDOFF had regressed. tools/facts-check.js flags (1) any sentence that matches a 'wrong' pattern, unless it also matches 'unless', and (2) any entry past its 'staleBy' date. Every 'wrong' pattern is a sentence shape found live on the site on 2026-10-01; each has a control in tools/facts-check.test.js. Add an entry whenever a fact appears on two pages or has been gotten wrong once.

facts.fact: North Myrtle Beach requires a business license for a short-term rental. There is no separate STR permit, inspection or local-agent rule in force.
facts.quote: There is currently no special zoning or permit process required beyond standard licensing.

wrong.note: No local-agent rule is in force in North Myrtle Beach.
No STR permit; business license only.

facts.fact: A rental's property tax bill in Horry County is about 3.3 times (unincorporated) to 4.3 times (City of Myrtle Beach) an owner-occupant's, on 2025 and 2026 millage. The 6 percent vs 4 percent ratio alone is 1.5 times; the school operating exemption on a legal residence makes the gap larger.

wrong.note: It is 3.3 to 4.3 times, not double. Link /buyers/property-taxes/.

facts.fact: A short-term rental inside the City of Myrtle Beach collects about 13 percent in total lodging taxes: 10 percent state and local sales tax on accommodations, plus county hospitality 1.5 percent, city hospitality 1 percent and city accommodations 0.5 percent.

wrong.note: 10 percent is only the state and local sales-tax layer; the total is about 13 percent.

facts.fact: South Carolina treats a stay of fewer than 90 continuous days as transient for accommodations tax.
facts.quote: supplied to the same person for a period of ninety continuous days are not considered proceeds from transients

wrong.note: The state line is 90 days, the same as the city's.
The state line is 90 days, the same as the city's.

facts.fact: Pawleys Island is entirely in Georgetown County. Murrells Inlet straddles the Horry and Georgetown county line.
facts.source: Census place records, as recorded in the website's MISTAKES.md item 9 and research/relocating/local-facts.md; Horry County 2026 levy lists the Murrells Inlet - Garden City Fire District

wrong.note: Pawleys Island is entirely in Georgetown County (website MISTAKES 9).

wrong.pattern: Murrells Inlet,[^.]{0,60}\bare in Georgetown County\b|Murrells Inlet (?:is )?(?:entirely )?in Georgetown County
wrong.note: Murrells Inlet straddles the line; Horry levies a Murrells Inlet - Garden City fire district.

facts.fact: South Carolina's age-65 deduction of up to $15,000 is reduced by any retirement income deduction the same person claims. The two do not stack.
facts.quote: 12-6-1170(B): reduced by any amount the taxpayer deducts

wrong.note: The age-65 deduction is reduced by the retirement deduction (website HANDOFF trap).

facts.fact: From tax year 2026 South Carolina has no standard deduction. The SC Income Adjusted Deduction is $15,000 single and $30,000 joint, phasing out to $0 at $95,000 single and $190,000 joint federal AGI.
facts.source: SCDOR Information Letter 26-20 (Act 110 of 2026), via https://dor.sc.gov/ ; re-open the letter itself before changing the figure

wrong.note: It is the SCIAD and it phases out; there is no SC standard deduction from 2026.

facts.fact: South Carolina's 48-hour notice before a budget vote does not apply to an association incorporated under the SC Nonprofit Corporation Act, which most are (27-30-140(2)).

wrong.note: State the nonprofit-corporation exemption with the rule (website HANDOFF trap).

facts.fact: In Horry County the wind pool coastal area is east of U.S. 17 or Bypass 17, whichever is farther west (38-75-310(5)(c)). In Myrtle Beach that is the Bypass.

wrong.note: The line is US 17 or Bypass 17, whichever is farther west.
The Intracoastal line is the rule for Beaufort, Colleton and Charleston, not Horry.

facts.fact: On a nonresident seller's South Carolina sale, the buyer is responsible for withholding. A closing attorney is not liable for collection but remits what it withholds (12-8-580).

wrong.note: The statute puts the duty on the buyer.

facts.fact: South Carolina's deed recording fee, $3.70 per $1,000, is owed by the seller (the grantor), except on a master-in-equity or government deed (12-24-10, 12-24-20).

wrong.note: The seller owes the deed fee.
A deed-stamp amount in a buyer's budget. The seller owes the deed fee.

facts.fact: A written buyer agreement before touring comes from the 2024 NAR settlement practice rules applied through the MLS, not from South Carolina statute.

wrong.pattern: \bSouth Carolina requires a written buyer\b|\bSC law requires a (?:written )?buyer\b
wrong.note: It is an MLS practice rule, not state law.

facts.fact: Myrtle Beach's short-term rental conversion overlay is Ordinance 2024-69, adopted December 10, 2024.
McLeod Health Carolina Forest cut its ribbon on August 27, 2026.
facts.source: McLeod Health release dated 2026-09-01, recorded in the website's research/invest-next/construction-pipeline-facts.md line 73

wrong.pattern: McLeod[^.]{0,120}\b(?:on schedule to open|slated to open|in progress|will open)\b|\b(?:in progress|slated to open)\b[^.]{0,80}McLeod
wrong.note: It opened; update to the ribbon-cutting date.
McLeod Carolina Forest was one of the three and it has opened. The count is now one fewer.

facts.fact: The site never states a mortgage or interest rate (owner non-negotiable 3). This entry exists so the market report's monthly rate line is caught when it returns.

wrong.note: No stated rates.

facts.fact: Listings show a gate at the main entrance on TPC Boulevard at Seasons at Prince Creek West, with a call box for visitors (ledger rows 92 and 93, verified 2026-10-11). The page states that plainly, with recent home listings named in the sources line. No primary source says the gate is staffed or gives hours: two 2025 listings give different guard hours (row 94). Never 'staffed', never guard hours, never 'gated' as a verified fact.
facts.quote: THE CALLBOX IS LOCATED AT THE MAIN GATE ON TPC (MLS 2522381). Ledger: batches/2026-10-a/facts/seasons-at-prince-creek-west-facts.md rows 50 to 53 and 90 to 95; PROS-CONS-candidates.md, Verifier check, Seasons P1.

wrong.note: Only a gate at the main entrance with a call box is verified (listings, rows 92 and 93). Do not call Seasons gated or verified gated.

wrong.pattern: (?:\bSeasons\b|\bTPC\b|\bPrince Creek\b)[^.]{0,160}\b(?:staffed|manned|attended|guard(?:ed|house| house| gate| booth)?|security guard)\b|\b(?:staffed|manned|attended|guard(?:ed|house| house| gate| booth)?|security guard)\b[^.]{0,160}(?:\bSeasons\b|\bTPC\b|\bPrince Creek\b)
wrong.note: No primary source says the Seasons gate is staffed or has a guard (row 94: two listings disagree). Say a gate with a call box for visitors.
Guard hours are not verified (row 94: one listing says 8 to 4, another 9 to 5). Leave hours out.

facts.fact: No primary source says Del Webb at Grande Dunes is gated. The HOA's hurricane guide mentions gate arms without saying where, and Pulte called the Ocean Club gated, not the neighborhood.
facts.quote: Any gate arms will be removed (hurricane guide; place not given). Ledger: batches/2026-10-a/facts/del-webb-grande-dunes-facts.md rows 36 and 59, hub check.

wrong.pattern: Del Webb at Grande Dunes[^.]{0,200}\bgated\b|\bgated\b[^.]{0,120}Del Webb at Grande Dunes
wrong.note: Not verified gated. Leave the gate out.

facts.fact: Myrtle Trace HOA dues are $95 a month from January 1, 2026. They were $90 in 2025.
facts.quote: there will be an increase in resident's dues to $95.00 a month

wrong.note: $90 was the 2025 fee. It is $95 a month from January 2026.

facts.fact: The HOA fee in Del Webb at Grande Dunes is about $400 a month for a house and about $445 for a villa (MLS listings entered in 2026). The hub's old $317 and $384 are 2022 and 2023 listing figures, so no 55+ fee range ends at $384.
facts.quote: Houses (MLS type Detached): $401 a month on 20 of 30 listings ... Villas (MLS type Semi-Detached): $445 on 6 of 13 listings

wrong.note: Old listing figures. Houses about $400, villas about $445; the hub range is 'from $43 a month'.

facts.fact: The HOA fee in Seasons at Prince Creek West is about $340 a month (MLS listings in 2026: $342 on 7 of 8). It includes internet, weekly trash pickup and lawn care.

wrong.note: Not sourced. Use about $340 a month.

unsourced._comment: Figures that appear on the site with no primary source and disagree across pages (facts audit, section 2). Use none of them until one is sourced, then promote it to a fact above.
